items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Ray Perry as someone who 'used to come and set in with us', but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not provide any personal testimony, memory, or confirmation of a direct interaction or relationship with Ray Perry.

ctx.x: No, he was--he came down there with a show. He was working on Miami Beach. I forgot the name of the band he was working with. And I'll tell you another guy used to come and set in with us by the name of Ray Perry.
